Fixed Epsilon-Greedy · Decaying Epsilon · Optimistic Initialization · UCB1 · Thompson Sampling
Epsilon-greedy explores uniformly at random; UCB1 adds an analytic uncertainty bonus based on action visit counts; Thompson Sampling samples from Bayesian posterior distributions over reward models.

Behavior Cloning (BC) · DAgger · Inverse RL (IRL) · GAIL

Behavior Cloning treats demonstrations as supervised data; DAgger aggregates states visited by the agent and queries an expert for corrective actions to overcome covariate shift; IRL recovers the underlying reward function; GAIL uses adversarial occupancy matching.

Governs the highest achievable expected return from state s by choosing the action maximizing expected immediate plus future value.

Updates toward the maximum action value at the successor state, independent of the executed action.
